title: Summarize paid sales
description: Count paid sales and sum integer minor-unit amounts; keep pending and refunded sales out of revenue.
program: ASSERT(EVERY(input.sales, (sale) -> sale.amount_cents != null), "Every sale needs amount_cents")
ASSERT(EVERY(input.sales, (sale) -> sale.status == "paid" || sale.status == "pending" || sale.status == "refunded"), "Unknown sale status")

exercise.instruction: Change S-2 status from pending to paid, then run again.

edgeCases.name: Empty sales have a zero total
Refunded sales are excluded and zero paid sales count

recipe.problem: Produce a small revenue summary from a single-currency sales feed. Count only paid records.
prerequisites: currency is required. All sales must already use that one currency.
sales is a required array. Each sale has status paid, pending, or refunded and a nonnegative integer amount_cents.
explanation: The assertions reject missing amounts, negative amounts, and unrecognized statuses before aggregation.
paid keeps only records whose status is paid. SUM adds their amount_cents, including a legitimate zero amount.
excluded_count reports records that did not contribute. An empty array has count 0 and total 0.
limits: A refunded record is excluded; this is gross paid revenue, not a ledger that subtracts refunds.
No currency conversion, rounding, tax, duplicate detection, or currency minor-unit lookup is performed.
Keep amounts and the aggregate within the cross-runtime safe integer range; this recipe makes no arbitrary-precision guarantee.
